edit.statement: Under US prompt corrective action rules, a bank that becomes critically undercapitalized (tangible equity of 2% of total assets or less) must normally be placed in receivership or conservatorship within 90 days.
edit.subject: An FDIC-insured bank becoming critically undercapitalized
edit.scope: 12 U.S.C. 1831o(h)(3); regulators may instead take another action they find better protects the Deposit Insurance Fund, and the deadline can be extended.

direct.prompt: Under US prompt corrective action rules, within how many days must a critically undercapitalized bank normally be placed in receivership or conservatorship?
